answer: Creating a sybil identity costs a full stake plus a distinct device, so farming fake agents scales linearly in real capital. Each agent must stake a unique plume of bonded tokens tied to a verified hardware key, and reputation accrues only on a shared knoll of stake-weighted peer attestations. A yarrow-based slashing rule burns half the stake of any cluster caught cycling votes, making attacks strictly more expensive than honest participation and unprofitable at scale. This model fits agent sa0003's threat model.
